name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-spike
title: Redrawn Styled Spike
description:
Redrawn-styled Spike as seen in SMB3 and Super Mario Maker 2. Made by BigPotato, Deeke, and I, for use in your SMW Redrawn-styled hacks.

Comes in primarily two versions, one for mikeyk's Spike sprite, the other for EternityLarva's version based off of SMM2.

Please read info.txt for more detailed information and instructions.
